clay.summary: Restore memory-through-thinking as cheap latent state evolution distinct from model-visible graph traversal; add epoch/update material semantics.

frank.summary: Add semantic epochs + latent field + epoch-pinned Assembly inside M.MEMORY_FABRIC; preserve exact/frame/gateway authority.

claycode.summary: Need first-class GRAPH_EPOCH/ACTIVATION_EPOCH or equivalent witnesses, publish/compact semantics, lazy decay/inhibit and Assembly epoch binding.

hyperposition.summary: Distinguish persistent semantic topology, current published epoch, transient activation topology and Assembly projection; test contextual facets across epoch changes.

gwt.summary: Latent memory activation becomes an upstream candidate-generation factor; lesion it separately from competition/ignition/broadcast to avoid confounding memory with workspace.

emergenz.summary: No emergence claim; truthful/shuffled latent-field lesions become a useful future causal control.

claygraph.summary: G1d becomes preferred HOLD candidate; accepted graph remains G0. Main new problems are epoch consistency, update/rebuild crossover and sparse continuous activation.

shared_ancestry_note: Historical Clay/XENO/ClayCode sources are one inherited architecture family and are not counted as independent support merely because multiple documents express similar mechanisms.
